headline: Court Upholds Ban on PAC-to-PAC Transfers
snippet: 11th Circuit upheld ban. AL Democratic Conference had challenged the law.

headline: Alabama Lobbyists PAC It In: Special Session Delivers Sweeping Ethics Reform
snippet: Seven ethics bills overhauled campaign finance. PAC-to-PAC ban ended lobbyist shell games.

headline: Ala. House passes ban on PAC-to-PAC transfers again
snippet: Passed 101-0. Had passed House for 10 years but died each year in Senate until special session.
